faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers on news, Exur chat, and what the app will not do.

items.whatA: Exur is a focused market-intelligence app. Scored news bullets for the market you select, plus an Exur co-pilot when you connect an account. Browse headlines without signing in.
items.newsA: Curated headlines ranked for relevance to your selected market, so you can scan what matters instead of scrolling feeds.
items.chatbotA: No. Exur is built for market context. It reads the headlines and market you have open, then returns focused answers, not open-ended chat.
items.askA: Anything about the active market or a headline you are reading: why it matters, what to watch next, or how it fits the wider tape.
items.accountA: Not to browse news. Open the app and read headlines without signing in. Connect an account for co-pilot chat, history, and plan limits on Free or Plus.
items.freeQ: How do Free and Plus differ?
items.freeA: Free includes the full news feed with a daily co-pilot send cap and a weekly usage limit. Plus raises both for people who use Exur every session.
items.profitsA: No. News scores and co-pilot replies support your process. They are not promises of return, win rate, or accuracy. Exur is analysis, not financial advice.

0.q: Does today’s ETF news matter for ETH?
0.a: Yes. Spot inflows flipped positive. Watch if funding stays soft while price lifts.

1.a: Not yet. Spot leads, but no clean setup. Wait above VWAP; stop under the prior low.

2.a: Leverage is unwinding — the crowd isn’t long yet. Don’t rush an entry.

3.q: Exchange reserves are low — good or bad?
3.a: Usually less sell pressure. Alone it isn’t a buy signal without spot confirmation.

4.a: No. Tape is mixed and leverage is still coming off. No clear edge today.

5.a: Weak. Price is quiet and no headline is strong. Wait for news or a level break.

6.a: Gold is near highs with a soft dollar. Prefer gold for lower risk; wait for a clear crypto signal.

7.a: Spot ETF inflows flipping positive. You can ignore the rest for now.

8.a: Spot a bit stronger, leverage still cautious. Don’t chase — wait for a confirmed level.

9.a: No strong signal. I’ll ping you the moment a headline or level flips.

about.title: What is Exur?
about.intro: Exur is a market-intel desk: public insight for the current candle, model context, news bullets (distilled headlines and summaries, not a raw wire), and an Exur co-pilot you can talk to in plain language when you connect an account.
about.whatBody: We're building a tool away from marketing theater: no slides, no empty promises, just the product. The homepage is the desk: pulse stance, model board, payoff geometry, and news bullets in one place, with Exur available as a co-pilot for signed-in users.
about.publicBody: Guests can open the <desk>public desk</desk> and see market pulse, insights, model context, and news bullets without signing in. Freshness labels use timestamps from the API, such as when an insight was generated or when a story was published, not login state. We do not treat authentication as proof of “live” or delayed data.
about.helpsBody: Exur organizes market information for the candle you're looking at: headline stance, how models sit relative to each other, payoff shape, and news bullets: short distilled stories with source context, not a raw news feed. The co-pilot is there to answer questions about that desk in plain English, as support for analysis, not a substitute for your own judgment.
about.privateBody: Connecting with Google unlocks account features such as co-pilot chat. Trade Desk and related premium guidance are treated as private / member capabilities when available. Turn-by-turn desk guidance is the product direction, not brokerage order execution on this site. Public pages do not expose private account data for search engines.
about.trustBody: Markets change. Timestamps describe when available content was generated or published. Insights and co-pilot replies are tools for analysis and decision-making, not guaranteed outcomes. Nothing on Exur promises profit, risk-free trades, or guaranteed accuracy.
about.helloBody: Still curious? Reach us on X.
